name: Oregon Zoo Wildlife Leaders
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the zoo and lead activities for guests. They do hands on nature work around the Portland area and learn about zoo careers.
who_can_apply: Teens from the Portland metro area who are 13 to 15 on April 12 of the program year. Selected by application and interview (about 30 teens).
duration: 10 weeks; at least one 6-hour shift a week for 8 of the 10 weeks
deadline_text: 2026 applications have closed. Applications usually open in January and stay open about three weeks. Check the page for summer 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online in January. Then interview. Chosen leaders go to an orientation and trainings in spring (the page lists March 29, April 12 and May 17).
notes: Ages 13 to 15 only. No direct animal contact in the first year. The page says the program does not guarantee future employment.
